entries.claim: FanDuel is a US daily fantasy sports (DFS), regulated online sportsbook, and online casino brand, owned by Flutter Entertainment plc.
entries.source_ref: Flutter Entertainment plc investor disclosures / official pages

entries.claim: US sports betting is licensed state-by-state following the 2018 PASPA repeal (Murphy v. NCAA).
entries.source_ref: US Supreme Court decision + state regulator rules

entries.claim: Real-time sports data is sourced from providers such as Sportradar and Genius Sports (official league data partnerships).
entries.source_ref: Public partnership reporting; vendor identity requires confirmation

entries.claim: Odds/pricing engines update in-play markets on a sub-second cadence.
Geolocation gating (GeoComply-style) enforces licensed state boundaries before wagering.
entries.source_ref: Public reporting/docs; exact vendor requires network-trace confirmation

entries.claim: KYC/AML onboarding and responsible-gaming controls (limits, self-exclusion, reality checks) are regulatory requirements for real-money operators.
Anti-collusion monitoring is used to protect DFS contest integrity.
entries.source_ref: Public reporting on DFS integrity practices

entries.claim: DraftKings Inc. is a listed peer operator on NASDAQ (DKNG).
FanDuel reports/derives revenue at a segment level within Flutter; no standalone audited FanDuel accounts are published.
entries.source_ref: Flutter annual/half-year report structure (cite period when used)

entries.claim: The FanDuel client delivery model and auth/KYC/geolocation vendor integrations are not determinable without an artefact.
Exact state/provincial licence numbers and any vig/rake/revenue figures are not asserted and require regulator-register or filing reads.
entries.source_ref: Regulator registers + Flutter filed reports; never to be fabricated

entries.claim: The odds/risk engine internals are server-side and proprietary; the wager life cycle here is a synthesised model, not observed code.
